a gap inside parentheses belongs to the call

name: several blank lines and a line of spaces inside braces belong to them
the block goes on after the bracket closes, up to the next blank line
a gap in a function in a functions block does not make the block a query

V

name: an unclosed brace does not join the queries below when a later function balances itself
a bracket in a comment is not one
a bracket in a note above a query is not one
a bracket in a string is not one
a quote with a backslash before it does not end the string
a backslash escapes nothing in a verbatim string
a string that is not closed ends with its line
a gap in a multi-line string belongs to it
a bracket in a multi-line string is not one
a multi-line string that is never closed does not join the queries below
a closing bracket with nothing open is ignored
